'''PL-8 Piercer Missiles''' were a type of [[Concussion missile/Legends|concussion missile]] manufactured by [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian Engineering Corporation]]. The [[Barloz-class medium freighter/Legends|''Barloz''-class medium freighter]] [[Solar Flare (Barloz-class)|''Solar Flare'']] was armed with PL-8 Piercer Missiles.<ref name="LE" />
